   Senator Klimesh made the motion to move Senate File 2464 from
the Appropriations Calendar to the Unfinished Business Calendar,
and requested a record roll call.

  On the question “Shall the bill be moved to the Unfinished Business
Calendar?” (S.F. 2464), the vote was:
Yeas, 31:

Alons            Bousselot        Campbell         Costello
Dawson           Dickey           Driscoll         Evans
Green            Gruenhagen       Guth             Klimesh
Koelker          Kraayenbrink     Lofgren          McClintock
Pike             Reichman         Rozenboom        Salmon
Schultz          Shipley          Sinclair         Sires

Westrich         Whitver          Zumbach

Nays, 15:

Bennett          Bisignano        Blake            Donahue
Dotzler          Drey             Hardman          Knox

Weiner           Winckler         Zimmer

Absent, 4:

Garrett          Rowley           Trone Garriott   Wahls

  The motion passed and Senate File 2464 was moved to the
Unfinished Business Calendar.

   The Senate stood at ease at 3:17 p.m. until the fall of the gavel for
the purpose of a Democratic party caucus.
72nd Day                   TUESDAY, MARCH 24, 2026                    633



   The Senate resumed session at 4:12 p.m., President Sinclair
presiding.

                           LEAVE OF ABSENCE

  Leave of absence was granted as follows:
  Senator Lofgren, until he arrives, on request of Senator Klimesh.

                       CONSIDERATION OF BILL
                      (Unfinished Business Calendar)

   Senator Klimesh asked and received unanimous consent to take up
for consideration Senate File 2464.

Senate File 2464

   On motion of Senator Costello, Senate File 2464, a bill for an act
relating to state finances by modifying the taxes imposed on health
maintenance organizations, making transfers from the taxpayer relief
fund, making and supplementing appropriations to the department of
health and human services, and including effective date, contingent
effective date, and retroactive applicability provisions, placed on the
Unfinished Business Calendar on March 24, 2026, was taken up for
consideration.

   Senator Costello offered amendment S–5125, filed by the senator
from the floor, striking and replacing everything after the enacting
clause and amending the title page of the bill, and moved its adoption.

  Amendment S–5125 was adopted by a voice vote.

  Senator Costello asked and received unanimous consent that
House File 2739 be substituted for Senate File 2464.

House File 2739

   On motion of Senator Costello, House File 2739, a bill for an act
relating to state finances by modifying the taxes imposed on health
maintenance organizations, making transfers from the taxpayer relief
fund, making and supplementing appropriations to the department of
health and human services, and including effective date, contingent
effective date, and retroactive applicability provisions, placed on the
Unfinished Business Calendar on March 24, 2026, was taken up for
consideration.
634                        JOURNAL OF THE SENATE                    72nd Day



   Senator Costello moved that the bill be read the last time now and
placed upon its passage, which motion prevailed by a voice vote, and
the bill was read the last time.
